task.name: pick_remote_controller_transfer_board
task.description: Use the right arm to grasp the remote controller, transfer it to the left arm, and then place it on the chopping board.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the remote controller.
2. Grasp the remote controller with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to a transfer position.
4. Move the left arm to the transfer position to receive the remote controller.
5. Grasp the remote controller with the left arm.
6. Release the remote controller from the right arm.
7. Move the left arm to align with the chopping board.
8. Release the gripper to place the remote controller on the chopping board.
